independent_validations.title: Synthetic powder-diffraction geometry and selection-rule comparison with pymatgen
independent_validations.claim_supported: For four named synthetic CIF fixtures, DiffractScout/Gemmi and pymatgen XRDCalculator agree on the tested d-spacing groups, 2θ positions, and stated selection rules within the reported numerical tolerances.
independent_validations.tolerance_basis: Constants in scripts/compare_reference_engines.py are fixed before comparison: d-spacing grouping/matching tolerance 1e-6 Å; every matched group must satisfy |Δd| <= 1e-6 Å and |Δ2θ| <= 1e-5 degrees; analytic selection-rule expectations are read from the hashed benchmark expectations file.
independent_validations.radiation: Cu Kα, effective single wavelength 1.5406 Å
independent_validations.limitations: Synthetic CIF fixtures only; this is a software-engine cross-check, not experimental validation, a real-material property claim, research-impact evidence, or external-user adoption. Intensity differences are diagnostic and have no acceptance threshold.
independent_validations.notes: The input_sha256 field identifies the shared synthetic fcc_al.cif fixture. The machine-readable receipt also records separate SHA-256 values for bcc_fe.cif, nacl.cif, and simple_cubic_al.cif, plus the expectations file, software versions, and per-peak results. The immutable GitHub URL points to the report section at the exact public candidate commit.

independent_validations.title: Synthetic cubic directional Young's-modulus comparison with pymatgen
independent_validations.claim_supported: For one explicitly synthetic cubic stiffness matrix and three declared directions, DiffractScout and an independently contracted pymatgen compliance tensor agree within the reported tolerance.
independent_validations.tolerance_basis: Constants in scripts/compare_reference_engines.py are fixed before comparison: |ΔE| <= max(1e-8 GPa, 1e-10 × |E_pymatgen|) for [100], [110], and [111].
independent_validations.tensor_source: Explicit synthetic 6x6 cubic stiffness matrix in validation_cases/independent_engines/reference_engine_comparison.json at elasticity.synthetic_stiffness_GPa
independent_validations.tensor_frame: Conventional cubic Cartesian frame defined by the synthetic Fm-3m fcc_al.cif (a = 4 Å); no coordinate transformation is tested
independent_validations.voigt_convention: Voigt order [11, 22, 33, 23, 13, 12] with engineering shear strain
independent_validations.limitations: Synthetic stiffness matrix only; this is a numerical convention/implementation cross-check, not validation of an experimental or database tensor, a real-material property claim, research-impact evidence, or external-user adoption.
independent_validations.notes: The input_sha256 identifies the shared synthetic fcc_al.cif fixture. The result JSON records the tensor, per-direction values, versions, and tolerances. The immutable GitHub URL points to the report section at the exact public candidate commit.
